# apple_app_custom_product_page (Resource)

Creates a custom product page: an alternative App Store page of an app, reached through its own URL. Add promotional text with `apple_app_custom_product_page_localization`, screenshots and previews with `apple_app_asset_library_placement` on a localization, and search keywords with `apple_app_custom_product_page_localization_search_keyword`; then submit the page with the `apple_submit_app_custom_product_page` action. An app can have 70 custom product pages. The deep link belongs to the version being prepared: once the page is approved, changing it starts the next version, which App Review must approve. Destroying the resource deletes the page, after which its URL opens the app's default page. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_custom_product_page" "summer" {
  app_id    = data.apple_app.example.id
  name      = "Summer Cup"
  deep_link = "https://example.com/summer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `name` (String) Reference name of the page, shown in App Analytics.

### Optional

- `deep_link` (String) Link that opens specific content in the app from the page, e.g. `https://example.com/summer`.
- `visible` (Boolean) Whether the page's URL opens the page. A URL that isn't visible opens the app's default product page. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the custom product page.
- `state` (String) State of the page's version being prepared, or else of its current version, e.g. `PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION`, `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW` or `APPROVED`.
- `url` (String) URL of the page on the App Store.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_custom_product_page.summer
  identity = {
    id = "eb2b3606-2fef-4aab-a54e-b2e5547c9bc3"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the custom product page.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_custom_product_page.summer eb2b3606-2fef-4aab-a54e-b2e5547c9bc3
```
